summary: Inter & Co filed a 6-K disclosing operational details and schedule for discontinuation of its Level II Sponsored BDR program (B3: INBR32), each BDR representing one Class A share (NASDAQ: INTR), following CVM Official Letter 81/2026. The board approved the plan January 26, 2026, plus cancellation of its CVM category A foreign issuer registration. Holders elect: receipt of NASDAQ Class A shares, receipt of Level I unsponsored BDRs (INBR34), or Sales Facility sale of underlying shares on NASDAQ, which applies absent election. The Selection Period opens September 16, 2026. Watch election uptake and Nasdaq selling pressure from the Sales Facility overhang.
